high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by the account "wintourworld," which is located in New York, New York. The post features a photograph of Anna Wintour, the editor-in-chief of Vogue magazine, walking outdoors on a sunny day. People: Anna Wintour is the central figure in the image. She is wearing a vibrant, floral-patterned dress with a mix of blue, red, and green colors. The dress has long sleeves and a flared skirt. She is also wearing a statement necklace and striped espadrille shoes.
